verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's first-party docs describe round-robin pooling for sales teams. Each host in the rotation can be given a priority, and an "Optimize for evenness" mode cycles bookings through the team for equal distribution, as an alternative to "Optimize for availability". Per-host meeting limits and custom hours also help keep load fair. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of fair distribution, and explicit proportional weighting beyond priority ordering.
